note: Owner notes on occurrences that stay UNRESOLVED. A note is not a ruling: it records what the owner believes the token means here, and why that belief is not strong enough to certify. The row keeps its place in the queue and the token keeps its counts.
why: Some cases are decided-enough to write down but not decided-enough to count. Before this file the only two options were 'resolve it' (which moves certified mention counts) or 'say nothing' (which loses the reasoning and invites the same case being re-derived from scratch). Notes are the third state: visible work-in-progress, zero effect on certified data.
retrieval: Attached by scripts/build-resolution-queue.mjs to the queue row with the matching id, as `ownerNote`. Ids that no longer exist in the queue are ignored — a note on a row that was later resolved is stale, not an error.
